data.one_liner: Mediation adapter to send ad requests to the InMobi ad network using google_mobile_ads.
data.what_it_does: This plugin acts as a mediation adapter allowing the Google Mobile Ads SDK to serve ads from the InMobi ad network. It bridges the Flutter layer with native platform code using Pigeon. Developers can display InMobi ads alongside other ad networks through Google Mobile Ads mediation.
use_when: You are already using the google_mobile_ads plugin in your Flutter app
You want to monetize your app by mediating ads through the InMobi network
avoid_when: You are not using the google_mobile_ads plugin
You do not use InMobi for ad monetization
strengths: Enables InMobi mediation for Google Mobile Ads in Flutter
Maintained officially in coordination with Google's mobile ads ecosystem
weaknesses: Strictly dependent on the google_mobile_ads plugin
Requires proper configuration of native ad networks on both Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up the InMobi SDK and adapters on both Android and iOS native sides alongside the google_mobile_ads plugin configuration.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only want standard Google Mobile Ads without InMobi mediation.

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer AppLovin MAX as your primary ad mediation platform instead of Google Mobile Ads.
